seoTitle.en: Ikigai Test: Four Overlap Lenses & Free Full Results

introduction.zh: 一件小活动可能让你想练一点东西，也可能让你先关心别人需要什么、怎样安排支持。本版借现代四圆图里热情、使命、职业、天职四组常见交叠，写了16道假想情境，只问你更想先探索哪一组问题。喜欢与擅长不是同一件事，支付条件也不代表已经有收入或市场；选择不把这些未知变成事实。四圆图与日本ikigai更广泛的日常含义并不等同，关系、爱好和小事也可以有意义，不必合成一份有薪工作。本版不是传统公式、标准Ikigai9或职业能力测量。所有最高并列都逐份呈现全文，不从全四项并列推理想中心，也不叫你补齐所谓被忽略的两圈。四份完整说明免费，也可以先读再决定是否作答。
introduction.en: A small activity may make you want to practise something, understand a person’s need or explore support arrangements. This edition uses Passion, Mission, Profession and Vocation, four familiar overlaps from a modern map, for sixteen original hypothetical situations asking which questions you would explore first. Enjoyment is not proficiency, and payment conditions establish neither income nor a market; choosing a question cannot turn those unknowns into facts. The map is not equivalent to the broader everyday Japanese concept: relationships, hobbies and small activities can matter without becoming one paid role. This is neither a traditional formula, standard Ikigai9 nor career-capability measurement. Every highest tie receives its full guide, without an ideal centre inferred from four equal counts or prescribed neglected circles. All four guides are free to read before deciding to answer.

instructions.zh: 把每题看作一个可想象的小情境，比较四个问题，选择你此刻更想先了解的一组，不是证明你已经会做或能收到报酬。每题只选一项，16题全部选择后显示计数及每一份最高并列全文；四项都同为4次不代表完美中心。没有合适选项时可以退出，本版不解释未完成答卷。无需输入活动名称、收入、他人需要或私人经历。
instructions.en: Treat each item as a small hypothetical situation. Choose the pair of questions you would most like to explore first now, without claiming an existing skill or payment. Select one option per item. All sixteen selections produce counts and the full guide for every highest-count tie; four equal counts of four do not establish an ideal centre. You can exit if no option fits; incomplete attempts are not interpreted. No activity name, income, others’ needs or private experience is entered.

source.kind: FermatMind original hypothetical exploration choices using four familiar overlaps in the modern purpose diagram; not a Japanese traditional formula, Ikigai9 scale, psychological measurement or JobCannon bank. prompt.zh: 你有一个空闲下午，想试着做点有意思的小事。比较这些问题，你更想先想哪一个？
prompt.en: You have a free afternoon to try a small meaningful activity. Which question would you explore first?

title.zh: 热情视角：喜欢与练习
title.en: Passion: Enjoyment and Practice

summary.zh: 把喜欢的活动与愿意练习的具体环节一起看；这是探索问题的视角，不认证你已经擅长、会进入心流或应该把爱好变现。
summary.en: Explore enjoyment alongside something you would like to practise. This lens certifies neither existing skill, flow nor a need to monetise a hobby.

title.zh: 这个交叠视角怎样用
title.en: Using this overlap lens

paragraphs.zh: 现代四圆图常把Passion放在喜欢与擅长的交叠。本题借用这个常见名称，但题目只问你更想先探索哪组问题，没有测试你是否真的擅长。选择喜欢与练习，意味着这些情境中你愿意把活动本身的吸引力与一个可练的小环节放在一起考虑，而不是已经拥有某种天赋。它可以从很小的爱好开始，也不需要有观众、收入或一份终身工作才值得被认真对待。
paragraphs.en: In the modern four-circle map, Passion commonly names the overlap of enjoyment and skill. This edition uses that familiar name while asking only which questions you would explore first; it does not test whether you are actually skilled. Choosing enjoyment and practice means considering an activity’s appeal together with a small part you might practise in the imagined situations. It establishes no talent. The lens can begin with a modest hobby and needs neither an audience, income nor a lifelong occupation to become a useful subject for reflection.

title.zh: 计数选中了什么，没有选中什么
title.en: What the count selects and leaves unknown

paragraphs.zh: 本视角计数越多，只表示在这16个情境中，喜欢加练习这一组问题被选择得更多。你没有提交作品、接受技能检验或描述真实日常，因此不能推出你心流更强、学得更快、能力更好或轻视报酬。某次没有选择与需要、报酬相关的问题，也不说明现实中忽略了它们。选择是一种阅读入口，不能把同一组问题在测验里出现的次数变成人生里四个方面的比例。
paragraphs.en: More selections indicate only that enjoyment-and-practice questions were chosen more often among these sixteen situations. No work sample, skill assessment or actual daily record was supplied, so stronger flow, faster learning, greater ability or disregard for payment cannot be inferred. Passing over a needs-or-payment option does not establish neglect of either in real life. A choice supplies an entry into a guide, not a proportion of your life occupied by four circles. Even a sole highest count leaves the other topics available and says nothing about how much weight they deserve outside this quiz.

title.zh: 从一小段活动开始理解
title.en: Understanding it through a small activity

paragraphs.zh: 例如，你对把生活中的声音拼成一个短片段感兴趣，也想练习怎样安排停顿。可以把这两个问题并排放着：这段活动哪里让你愿意接近，哪一个环节可以小范围尝试？不需要先证明能赚钱，也不必承诺一直喜欢它。如果实际尝试后发现不是自己想要的，那是新信息，而不是结果失效或你不够投入。本问卷的选择并没有预先知道你会做得怎样。
paragraphs.en: Suppose you are interested in arranging everyday sounds into a short passage and would like to practise placing pauses. Put two questions alongside each other: what attracts you to the activity, and which small element could you try? You need not first prove that it can earn money or promise permanent interest. Finding after an attempt that it is not what you wanted provides new information rather than invalidating the result or proving insufficient commitment. The questionnaire’s selections did not establish how well you would do or whether an actual attempt would be enjoyable.

title.zh: 可选地试一个不必展示的片段
title.en: An optional attempt without an audience

paragraphs.zh: 如果愿意，可以选一个很小、可撤回的片段，只观察活动本身的体验与练习时遇到的问题。例如只试几种停顿，或只画一个角落，不要求做出可发布作品。你可以不保存、不分享，也可以在尝试后结束。这个建议不是训练方案，不保证提高能力或带来更强意义感；它只是让“我喜欢什么”和“我愿意练什么”从抽象词变成更具体的问题。
paragraphs.en: If useful, choose a small reversible fragment and notice the experience of doing it alongside the questions that arise in practice. Try a few pauses or sketch one corner, without requiring a publishable product. You can decline to keep or share it and stop after the attempt. This is not a training programme and promises neither improved ability nor increased meaning. It simply makes “what interests me” and “what would I practise” more concrete. Time, materials and your willingness still matter, and declining an experiment does not contradict the lens.

title.zh: 与另外三种交叠的比较
title.en: Comparing the other three overlaps

paragraphs.zh: 热情视角把喜欢与练习放在一起；使命视角把喜欢与别人表达的需要放在一起；职业视角关注练习与报酬条件；天职视角关注需要与报酬条件。这是对现代图的四组常见交叠做有限阅读，不是说生活只有这四种组合，也不说明某一组缺少另一组就必然危险。你可以同时对几组有兴趣，最高并列时每份全文都会保留。四项计数相同也不是所有现实条件都已齐备的中心认证。
paragraphs.en: Passion joins enjoyment with practice questions; Mission joins enjoyment with expressed needs; Profession concerns practice and payment conditions; Vocation concerns needs and payment conditions. These are limited readings of four familiar overlaps in a modern map, not a claim that life contains only four combinations or that one pair is inherently precarious without another. Several lenses may interest you, and every highest tie keeps its full guide. Equal counts across all four do not certify an ideal centre where actual conditions are satisfied. The counts do not independently measure the four underlying circles or establish missing ingredients.

title.en: Enjoyment and skill need not arrive together

paragraphs.en: You may enjoy something new without being proficient, or be proficient at work that currently generates little enthusiasm. Neither is a good-or-bad verdict from these counts. Whether a hobby should face a market or continue depends on your aims and circumstances; this lens cannot require quitting work, starting a business or monetising interest. It also cannot infer another person’s talent or describe someone who selected other questions as lacking joy. The exercise compares questions rather than testing whether a person has a complete life, a worthwhile activity or permission to change direction.

The answer can change without supplying this site with additional information. A count certifies neither stable interest, lasting progress nor a direction for your life; it is enough to leave with a clearer question.

summary.en: Consider an activity you enjoy alongside needs people have expressed, without inferring virtue, empathy, proven impact or an obligation to give without limits.

title.zh: 使命视角不是给你指定任务
title.en: Mission is not an assigned obligation

paragraphs.zh: 现代图里的Mission常把喜欢与世界需要并列。本版把“世界”收窄为可以具体核对的需要：谁自己说需要什么，与你愿意做的活动在哪里相遇。它不是在发现你命中注定的使命，也不要求把所有人的需要放在自己之前。选择这一组问题，仅说明在给定情境中你想先弄清活动吸引力和需要之间的联系；它不证明已经有受益者，更不确认你的活动一定能提供帮助。
paragraphs.en: Mission in the modern map commonly joins enjoyment and what the world needs. This edition brings “the world” down to needs that could be checked concretely: who has said they need what, and how that relates to an activity you would enjoy. It does not discover a destined mission or require everyone else’s needs to come first. Selecting these questions means wanting to examine that connection in the situation. It proves neither the existence of beneficiaries nor that the imagined activity would help them. No one’s actual needs or experiences are entered into the questionnaire.

title.zh: 选择需要问题，不等于已经了解需要
title.en: Choosing needs questions is not knowing the need

paragraphs.zh: 较多使命计数表示这组探索问题出现更多，不等于你能准确读懂别人、更加无私或会自然激励团队。需要是否真实、做法是否合适、结果有没有帮助，都要靠情境中的信息另核，问卷没有采集。也不能从另三项计数较少，推出你忽略练习或没有考虑支持条件。四组问题被迫各选其一，未选中的事项仍可能在现实里非常重要；数量只是本版阅读安排，不能变成道德排名。
paragraphs.en: More Mission selections mean these exploration questions appeared more often, not that you read people accurately, are more selfless or naturally inspire teams. Whether a need is real, an approach appropriate or an outcome helpful requires information the questionnaire does not collect. Fewer selections elsewhere cannot establish ignored practice or support conditions. Choosing one of four questions leaves other matters that may be important in real life unselected. The number organises this edition’s reading and supplies no moral ranking, measure of generosity or evidence about a group’s needs. A tie adds full guides rather than resolving those unknowns.

title.zh: 从对方说出的一个小需要开始
title.en: Beginning with one expressed need

paragraphs.zh: 例如，你喜欢写清楚一件事，朋友又明确说希望活动说明更容易找到。可以先问喜欢做哪部分，以及朋友具体想找哪些信息，而不是替他想象需要一份很大的宣传计划。如果对方不想要帮助，或希望采用别的方式，选择使命视角也不能否定那个意愿。问卷只给出一个可以比较的问题组合，没有测量实际沟通、服务效果或你是否适合从事某个助人职业。
paragraphs.en: Suppose you enjoy making information clear, and a friend explicitly says that an activity’s instructions are hard to find. A small clarified request is enough for the example; no one needs to disclose private difficulties.

title.en: Optionally checking scope and willingness

paragraphs.en: If useful, ask: “I would enjoy organising these few public details; is that the part you need?” Separate what you want to offer, what is requested and the limits of the offer. The person may decline, and you may withdraw or narrow it; your worth need not depend on being helpful. This small attempt promises no increased impact, meaning or relationship quality and requires no care, health or professional service. When a need cannot be checked, leaving it unknown is more appropriate than letting a result answer for someone else or create an obligation neither person chose.

Compare what you wanted to explore first rather than choosing the most meaningful, profitable or respectable lens. Every highest tie retains its full guide. Equal counts certify no ideal centre, actual capability or readiness to provide a service, and one lens cannot supply evidence missing from another.

title.zh: 关心别人可以保留自己的边界

paragraphs.en: You can care without having time to participate, or want to participate while needing payment, assistance or a clear scope. Willingness also establishes no competence, particularly for activities requiring qualifications, which the quiz does not provide. These selections recommend no social-work, teaching, counselling or healthcare role. Nor do unselected circles become built-in deficits. Decisions about participation and boundaries still depend on actual conditions, abilities, consent and resources rather than the name attached to a guide.

title.en: Profession: Practice and Payment

summary.zh: 并排探索练习、样例、交付与报酬条件；不认证真实技能、市场认可、财务稳定或适合任何职位。

title.zh: 职业视角在这里不是职业推荐
title.en: Profession is not a job recommendation here

paragraphs.zh: 现代图把Profession放在擅长与报酬的交叠。本题采用这个常见名称，但选项问的是若探索某种有报酬的活动，想先核对哪些练习与交付条件。选择它不表示你已经擅长、已有客户，或市场愿意付费。它也不局限于正式职业，可以只是思考一项很小的活动在什么范围内有条件被提供。没有实际技能资料、需求或支付信息时，这些仍然是问题，不是结果替你补出的事实。
paragraphs.en: Profession in the modern map commonly joins skill and payment. Selecting it does not establish proficiency, clients or a willing market. It need not concern a formal occupation; it can involve considering the conditions for providing one small activity within a limited scope. Without actual skill evidence, demand or payment information, these remain questions rather than facts supplied by a result. The quiz evaluates no work and makes no offer on your behalf.

title.zh: 先问条件，不等于已有条件

Passing over enjoyment or needs questions cannot establish empty work, absent enthusiasm or a lack of concern for others. Only one pair can be chosen at a time, while other questions may remain important in reality. The count is no percentage of professional proficiency, earning ability or likely career success.

title.zh: 用一个小样例理解练习与交付
title.en: Exploring practice and delivery through a small sample

paragraphs.zh: 例如，你想了解把几页公开资料整理成一份清楚的小目录，若作为有报酬的任务，需要什么。可以先区分练习样例能说明什么、对方希望收到什么、哪些内容尚不能承诺，以及报酬条件是否真实存在。这个例子没有判断你能否承接，也不提供定价或业务保证。问卷只是让你注意到可能需要核对的几类问题，不能从选择过它们推断已经完成了技能评估或市场验证。
paragraphs.en: Suppose you want to understand what would be involved in organising several pages of public material into a clear index for payment. Distinguish what a practice sample could show, what a recipient would expect, what cannot yet be promised and whether any payment arrangement actually exists. This example does not establish readiness to accept a task or provide pricing or business guarantees. It highlights questions that might require checking. Selecting those questions has completed neither a skill assessment nor market validation, and the quiz requests no sample, recipient details or financial information.

title.zh: 可选地分开样例、范围与未知
title.en: Optionally separating a sample, scope and unknowns

paragraphs.zh: 如果愿意，可以只在心里把三栏分开：可以拿来练习的小范围、仍需了解的交付条件，以及目前不知道的部分。不必马上收费、接单或公开展示。也可以先判断自己是否愿意让爱好进入这样的安排，保留不做有报酬活动的选择。这个回顾不是创业或职业方案，不保证你找到收入；它只让练习与交付之间的差别更清楚，不用想象中的报酬替代实际信息。
paragraphs.en: If useful, distinguish three columns privately: a small scope for practice, delivery conditions that remain to be understood, and what is currently unknown. There is no need to charge, accept work or display anything. You may first decide whether you even want a hobby to enter such an arrangement, retaining the choice not to offer a paid activity. This reflection is no business or career plan and guarantees no income. It clarifies the difference between practising and delivering without replacing actual information with an imagined payment or requiring action to make the result look correct.

title.zh: 报酬不是价值的唯一证明
title.en: Payment is not the only evidence of value

paragraphs.zh: 职业视角关心练习与报酬，热情视角关心喜欢与练习，天职视角关心需要与报酬，使命视角关心喜欢与需要。报酬条件并不自动包含喜欢、意义或别人想要的内容，但也不与它们冲突。不能因为这项计数较高，就宣布另外两圈被你忽略；本测验根本没有独立测四圈。若你也选择了其他最高视角，每份说明都完整保留，不用强行决定唯一职业人格；四项并列不意味着四个现实条件已经全部满足。
paragraphs.en: Profession concerns practice and payment, Passion enjoyment and practice, Vocation needs and payment, and Mission enjoyment and needs. Payment conditions neither automatically contain enjoyment, meaning or expressed demand nor conflict with them. A higher count cannot establish neglected circles, because the quiz did not independently measure the four circles. Other highest lenses retain their full guides rather than forcing one professional personality. Four equal counts do not mean that actual conditions have all been met. Nor does this modern map decide which activities deserve payment or which unpaid parts of life matter.

title.zh: 熟练、报酬与满足感都需要另看
title.en: Skill, payment and satisfaction remain separate questions

paragraphs.zh: 有人可能擅长一件事却不想把它当工作，也可能有报酬却仍在学习；都不能据本结果判断矛盾或失败。收入还涉及机会、资源和具体安排，这些没有被问卷核实。选择职业视角不说明你陷在所谓金手铐，也不证明可靠、纪律性强或已经获得市场尊重。涉及需要专门资质的活动，本结果不提供任何资格。它不给岗位列表或适配强弱，更不建议根据一个小计数改变工作或财务安排。
paragraphs.en: Someone may be skilled without wanting an activity to become work, or receive payment while continuing to learn. Neither is contradiction or failure established by this result. Income also involves opportunities, resources and specific arrangements not checked here. Selecting Profession does not imply golden handcuffs, reliability, discipline or market respect. For activities requiring qualifications, the result provides none. It supplies no job list or fit rating and does not recommend changing work or financial arrangements based on a count. Real choices need information about the activity and circumstances that these imagined selections do not contain.

title.zh: 把未核实的部分留作问题
title.en: Leaving unchecked conditions as questions

paragraphs.zh: 图的作者说明和日本政府文化特写提供背景，不验证本题本，也不把四圆图变成职业能力模型。本版没有移植竞品关于精通、收入、稳定与岗位强匹配的结论。可以只带走一个问题：我现在想练习的部分，与任何可能交付的内容之间，还有什么未知？不必填报收入、职业或私人经历。下次更关注喜欢或需要，也不意味着专业性下降；变化可能只是问题顺序不同，不认证能力或收入发生改变。
paragraphs.en: The diagram creator’s account and Japanese cultural feature supply background, not validation of this bank or a career-capability model. Competitor conclusions about mastery, income, security and strong job matches are not transferred. One question is enough to retain: what remains unknown between the part I would practise and anything that might eventually be delivered? No income, occupation or private experience needs reporting. Choosing enjoyment or needs first next time does not establish declining professionalism. The order of questions may simply differ, without certifying a change in competence, income or a stable career identity.

title.en: Sixteen choices and every highest tie

Choosing A throughout produces four counts of four and four full guides, not an ideal centre, satisfied circles or established life purpose. Unselected lenses do not establish neglected conditions, and a one-count gap has no validated psychological meaning. Retake differences prove no stable change. Incomplete or invalid input is not interpreted.

summary.zh: 探索明确需要与支付、支持和服务范围怎样相连；“天职”只是现代图的常见名称，不是命定岗位、可靠人格或已经创造的贡献。
summary.en: Explore expressed needs alongside payment, support and scope. Vocation is a familiar map label, not a destined role, reliable personality or proven contribution.

title.zh: “天职”是名称，不是命定结论
title.en: Vocation is a label, not a destiny

paragraphs.en: Vocation here names the modern map’s overlap of needs and payment. The familiar label does not discover what you are destined to do. Items ask only whether you would first explore a request together with conditions around payment, support and scope. They establish neither an actual need, social importance nor existing compensation. Putting the questions together highlights that “someone needs this” and “how could it be provided sustainably” still contain separate unknowns. A result cannot erase those unknowns or decide that responding to a request should become your role.

title.zh: 计数不证明实际贡献或稳定
title.en: Counts establish neither contribution nor stability

paragraphs.zh: 本项计数较多，仅表示需要与报酬条件这一组问题在这些假想情境中更常被你先选，不是可靠性、贡献程度或收入稳定性的量表。你也可能因不确定资源从哪里来而想先了解，问卷没有询问原因。其他选项较少不等于缺乏喜欢或练习，更不能说明你在自动驾驶地工作。每题四选一的安排只比较探索顺序，不能用来算你的人生里有多少需要、报酬、爱好或能力，也不确认你已经找到可持续活动。
paragraphs.en: More selections indicate only that needs-and-payment questions were chosen first more often in these imagined situations. They form no measure of reliability, contribution or income stability. Uncertainty about resources might itself prompt the choice, but the reason was not asked. Fewer other selections establish neither absent enjoyment or practice nor work on autopilot. Four alternatives compare an order of exploration, not proportions of needs, payment, interests or ability in your life. The count also cannot confirm that a sustainable activity has been found or that another person will welcome an offer.

title.zh: 需要与安排可以分别核对
title.en: Checking a request and its arrangements separately

paragraphs.zh: 例如，有人说需要把活动路线写得更容易理解。你想先弄清使用者具体要什么，以及是否有时间、场地、费用或其他支持安排。明确需要不等于你必须接受，存在费用也不代表活动已经合适或值得长期继续。还需要知道自己能提供什么、是否愿意提供，以及使用者是否接受这个范围。本问卷没有核实其中任何条件；例子只说明这组问题能怎样展开，不预测你会成为可靠服务者。

An expressed need does not require you to accept, and available money does not establish suitability or a reason for long-term continuation. What you can offer, whether you want to offer it and whether the scope is accepted remain separate matters. None has been verified by the questionnaire. The example shows how the questions might unfold, not that you will become a reliable provider or that a real service should begin.

title.zh: 可选地把支持条件说具体
title.en: Optionally making support conditions concrete

paragraphs.en: If useful, ask: “Which part is needed, and which time, resource or payment arrangements would need clarifying first?” Retain your own scope and anything you cannot currently provide. The exercise requires neither accepting work, charging, unpaid giving nor undertaking an activity beyond your capability; participation may be declined. Support is not limited to money, and hobbies or relationships need no market approval to matter. This simply places two questions requiring verification alongside each other. It promises no income, impact or professional fulfilment and does not replace the specific information needed for a real arrangement.

title.zh: 与另外三份读法一起保留未知
title.en: Keeping unknowns when comparing the other guides

paragraphs.zh: 天职视角连接需要与报酬，使命连接喜欢与需要，职业连接练习与报酬，热情连接喜欢与练习。它们不是“高尚”“务实”“有趣”等四种人格，任何一组都不证明另一组缺失。最高并列时可以比较多份全文，想法并存不需要被压成唯一称号。四组都同为4次，只反映本题选项计数相同，不说明你已到达四圆中心，也不测人生是否完整。现实中各问题的重要性，还需要你自己结合活动和条件判断。
paragraphs.en: Vocation connects needs and payment, Mission enjoyment and needs, Profession practice and payment, and Passion enjoyment and practice. They are not noble, practical or entertaining personalities, and one pair establishes no missing alternative. Highest ties allow comparison of several full guides rather than compressing coexisting questions into one identity. Four equal counts of four reflect only this questionnaire’s selections, not arrival at the diagram’s centre or a complete life. How important each question is in an actual activity remains for you to consider with the circumstances. No unchosen circle becomes a prescribed growth direction from these counts.

title.zh: 有需要不等于有义务
title.en: A need does not create an obligation

paragraphs.zh: 别人需要一件事，不代表你必须提供；你需要报酬或休息，也不意味着缺乏关怀。某种有报酬的活动可以很有意义，也可以只是阶段安排，结果不判断它是否配得上“天职”这个词。它不能确认能力、资格、支付稳定性或实际效果，尤其不能把本视角直接匹配到医疗、应急或其他需要专门条件的岗位。你是否参与、继续或退出，仍需要真实的信息和自己的选择，不能由测验名称替你承担。
paragraphs.en: Another person’s need creates no obligation for you to provide, and needing payment or rest establishes no lack of care. A paid activity may be meaningful or simply a temporary arrangement; the result does not judge whether it deserves the word vocation. It confirms neither capability, qualifications, stable payment nor actual outcomes, and it cannot match this lens directly to healthcare, emergency response or other roles requiring specific conditions. Participation, continuation and withdrawal still require real information and your choice. The name of a quiz cannot make those decisions or absorb their consequences on your behalf.

title.en: A lens can leave just one question

Judgments about a calling, meaning or contribution have not been validated by these sixteen items. You may leave with one question: what remains unclear between a need I want to understand and acceptable support and scope? No private information needs to be supplied and no lifelong plan is required. A later change of focus can remain a new question rather than evidence that personality, life value or a stable vocation has changed.

The creator’s account and cultural feature supply background without validating items or individual results. No diagram, competitor bank, guide text or strong job matches are copied. Relationships, hobbies and small activities can matter without paid work. Full text is free without another assessment. Drafts require opt-in, stay on this device for twenty-four hours and clear on completion, exit or retake; declining storage does not prevent completion. Sharing contains the test name, matched guide names and public links, never answers or counts. No activity name, income, others’ needs or private experience is collected.

question.zh: 这能测出我的人生使命或适合职业吗？
question.en: Can this measure my life purpose or a suitable career?

answer.zh: 不能。它只比较在假想情境里先探索哪组问题，不测能力、收入、市场需要、实际贡献或职业适配，也不解释健康或寿命。
answer.en: No. It compares which questions you would explore first in hypothetical situations, without measuring ability, income, demand, contribution, career fit, health or lifespan.

question.zh: 四圆图是日本传统公式吗？
question.en: Is the four-circle map a Japanese traditional formula?

answer.zh: 不是。作者说明它是把现代目的图与ikigai一词结合的延展；日本概念也可以涉及小事、爱好和关系，不要求四圈合成有薪工作。
answer.en: No. The creator describes combining a modern purpose map with the word ikigai. The broader concept can include small activities, hobbies and relationships without a paid role combining four circles.

question.zh: 并列或全选同一选项会怎样？
question.en: What happens with ties or choosing the same position?

answer.zh: 所有最高并列逐份呈现完整说明。全选A时四项各4次，显示四份全文，不认证完美中心或已经找到目的。
answer.en: Every highest tie gets its full guide. Choosing A throughout gives four counts of four and four full guides, without certifying an ideal centre or a found purpose.

question.zh: 这些全文免费吗，是否要填写收入？
question.en: Are full guides free, and must I provide income?

answer.zh: 四份全文全部免费，无另一测试解锁。不填写收入、活动名、他人需要或私人经历；分享也不带个人答案或计数。
answer.en: All four full guides are free without another assessment. No income, activity names, others’ needs or private accounts are entered; sharing carries no answers or counts.
